fit.summary: Runs a second-shift press line and owns OEE and scrap now; has led 9 operators, not 20 to 25.

bullets.text: Cut bracket line scrap from 4.1% to 2.3% with a first-piece inspection at every shift start

cover_letter.hook: A second shift where OEE, scrap, and safety all land on the supervisor is the job I already do as a line lead, and I want to run a full shift at Ridgeway.
cover_letter.body:
At Great Lakes Stamping I lead 9 operators on 12-hour rotating shifts. We raised press line OEE from 71% to 82% by standardizing die changeovers, and a first-piece inspection at each shift start cut bracket scrap from 4.1% to 2.3%.

Before I led the line I ran a 400-ton transfer press at 520 parts per hour, and I train new operators on lockout/tagout.
cover_letter.close: I would like to hear how your second shift handles changeovers between the stamping and weld cells.

gaps: Six Sigma Green Belt is preferred; Luis has not earned it.
The posting asks for 20 to 25 operators; Luis has led 9.
